node.statement: Vacuous-domain reduction: if S_P=0 then M_n tensor S_P=0 for every n and the asserted inequality is vacuous. Otherwise the isometric scalar-tensor inclusions in the operator-space structure make every M_n tensor S_P nonzero, so all lower moduli a_n used in nodes 1.2--1.4 are well-defined infima over nonempty sets.
